mainEntity.name: Do I need extra calories in the first trimester?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most women, no. The IOM adds no extra calories in the first trimester; extra needs start in the second trimester at about 340 kcal a day.

mainEntity.name: How many extra calories do I need with twins?

acceptedAnswer.text: The IOM did not set energy additions for twins. Needs are higher than for one baby, so your care team or a registered dietitian can give you a personal target.

mainEntity.name: How many extra calories does breastfeeding use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Making milk uses about 500 kcal a day in the first six months. Because some of that energy comes from body stores, the IOM adds about 330 kcal a day to your intake then, and about 400 kcal a day from 7 to 12 months.
